dedupe_keys.name: plexos energy market simulation software energy exemplar

description: PLEXOS is Energy Exemplar's commercial energy market simulation platform. The product page read on 2026-09-26 describes zonal and nodal simulation from long-term investment planning to intra-hour operations, co-optimisation of electricity, water and gas systems, renewable and ancillary service markets, hydro and pumped storage optimisation, gas planning, storage investment and operation, emissions, carbon capture and nuclear studies, and multi-objective decision optimisation. It says PLEXOS has been used for renewable integration studies since 2008 and for high-renewable integrated resource plans in many US states and other countries, that all equations, objective functions and constraints are open for users to review, and that a cloud version, AI-assisted features and simulation-ready datasets are offered. Coverage is any market a user models. Access is by commercial licence through sales, with a university programme listed; prices are not published and model files are in the vendor's formats. Caveats: studies depend on the input datasets chosen, and the page is promotional. Simulation uses are production cost and capacity expansion optimisation, integrated resource planning and gas and power co-planning. Related records: model-plexos-coad is an open Python tool for PLEXOS input files, and model-pypsa is an open energy system optimisation alternative.
